findings.description: The policy grants the deployment user unrestricted ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* actions against every resource. This violates least privilege and allows compromise of this user's access key to expose or alter data in any accessible S3 bucket, modify Lambda workloads, and control EC2 resources across the account.
